Habitat V0.5

Changelog

  • New: Updated compatibility with MacOS 27!
  • Improved: Wave audio sliders in menubar for inputs & outputs now have uniform size.
  • Improved: Wave ARK audio recognition. Starts and stops based on audio.
  • Improved: Notch nook now only shows on hover when over the black area, rather than just near the nook to prevent accidental openings.
  • Fixed: Notch Nook showing audio visualizer for random apps sometimes even though no audio was playing.
  • Fixed: Some Squeak mouse gestures not working on MacOS 27.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
